description: Ranked market table — coins sorted by market cap, volume, or ID, optionally selected by coin IDs or a category. Choose one selector; ids and category cannot be combined. Use for questions such as "top 20 DeFi coins". Returns standard market fields per coin (price, cap, volume, supply, 24h/1h/7d change, ATH/ATL). Discover valid category slugs with coingecko_list_categories and pass the category_id exactly.

category.description: Restrict to a category slug from coingecko_list_categories (e.g. "layer-1", "decentralized-finance-defi"). Cannot be combined with ids. Omit for an ID selection or all coins.

ids.description: Optional coin slugs; cannot be combined with category. First 250 unique normalized IDs are processed; accepts up to 500 raw entries and discloses skipped IDs separately.

order.description: Upstream sort order by market capitalization, trading volume, or CoinGecko ID.

page.description: 1-based page number for paging beyond per_page rows.

vs_currency.description: Currency to denominate the table in (e.g. "usd", "eur", "btc"). Single currency.

name: coingecko_list_markets

appliedIds.description: Normalized coin IDs applied to the upstream paginated selection.

cap.description: The per_page cap applied. Present only when the page is full.

coins.description: Ranked market rows for this page. Data provided by CoinGecko.

ath.description: All-time-high price in vs_currency, when available.

atl.description: All-time-low price in vs_currency, when available.

currentPrice.description: Current price in vs_currency, when available.

high24h.description: 24-hour high price in vs_currency, when available.

low24h.description: 24-hour low price in vs_currency, when available.

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in vs_currency, when available.

totalVolume.description: 24-hour trading volume in vs_currency, when available.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `conflicting_filters`: Both ids and a nonempty category were supplied; CoinGecko ignores IDs in that combination. `unknown_category`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 404 for a category-filtered request. `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_invalid_params`: CoinGecko rejected the request parameters with HTTP 400. `upstream_validation_failed`: CoinGecko rejected request validation with HTTP 422. `upstream_unauthorized`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 401, including credential or historical-window restrictions. `upstream_forbidden`: CoinGecko denied access with HTTP 402 or 403. `upstream_not_found`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 404 on an endpoint without a domain-specific missing result. `upstream_invalid_request`: CoinGecko rejected the HTTP request with another permanent client status or redirect. `upstream_conflict`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 409, 423, or 424. `upstream_timeout`: A CoinGecko attempt timed out or returned HTTP 408, 425, or 504. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The coin-detail request, conditional currency lookup, and their retries exceeded one 50-second deadline. `upstream_deadline`: An externally supplied deadline expired during the CoinGecko exchange. `upstream_http_error`: CoinGecko returned permanent HTTP 501 Not Implemented. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a transient 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

shown.description: Rows returned on this page. Present only when the page is full.

skippedIds.description: IDs skipped beyond the 250 unique-ID processing cap; not missing coins.

truncated.description: True when the page filled to per_page (more rows likely on the next page). Present only when the page is full.
